transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a five-year, $50 million sustainability-linked bond draft on the table for institutional investors. Before I can sign off, I need to hear from each of the relevant functions. Let's start with legal, then treasury, sustainability, and compliance. I'll note that the current draft carries the sustainability-linked label but is missing a coupon step-up, hedge amount, and post-issuance reporting controls. I'd like each of you to address those gaps as we go through your reports.
